## Your Trusted GlobalLuggage ShippingService

### Travel Light

Breeze through the airport and avoid paying [ extra airline baggage fees ][16] . It’s like a travel
agent for your bags, so you can carry less and travel light.

### Track Your Bags

Once your bags are on their way, our proprietary system monitors key milestones in their journey to
ensure everything stays on track. As soon as delivery is complete, we’ll notify you by email so you
can enjoy peace of mind knowing your luggage is ready and waiting for you.

### On-Time Guarantee

Relax. When you send your luggage with us, it is [ guaranteed to arrive ][17] on time or we’ll
refund you double what you paid to ship the bag.

### Premium Service

From hassle-free pickups to on-time deliveries, our white glove service ensures your luggage arrives
at your destination stress-free, allowing you to focus on your journey.

## Frequently Asked Shipping Questions

How much does it cost to ship luggage?

Our pricing starts at $99/bag. Pricing is available [online][35] or by calling +1 617-482-1100.

Luggage Forward uses baggage categories similar to what you would find with airlines; combining both
weight and size to create simple categories, making it easy to generate pricing on our website
without the exact weight or dimensions of your luggage.

Our all-inclusive pricing is more predictable and typically less expensive than a per-pound rate
because we do not have any additional fees or surcharges.

Pricing is determined based on the following three factors:
1. Origin and destination
2. Luggage category
3. Delivery speed

You can get instant pricing for [your specific trip][36] online.

Do I need a box to ship my luggage?

No, your luggage does not have to be boxed. You can pack your luggage as you normally would for
airline travel, no additional packaging is necessary.

One of the advantages of using Luggage Forward is that your soft and hard sided luggage can be
shipped as is. However, sporting equipment should have adequate padding around any fragile or
precision parts to ensure that they are protected during transit.

For more on preparing and packing your order, see our guide to [what you can and cannot ship][37].

Our complimentary value protection covers your luggage for up to $500 in the rare event that there
is damage beyond normal wear and tear. You may increase your value protection up until midnight the
day of your pick up.

How will I receive my shipping labels?

After your booking is placed, Luggage Forward will mail you a Forwarding Packet up to one week prior
to your pickup. The Forwarding Packet contains your itinerary, luggage tags, and relevant
instructions for packing and preparing your luggage for shipment with Luggage Forward. If you placed
a last-minute booking then the Forwarding Packet can either be emailed to you or it can be printed
at luggageforward.com by logging into [your account][38].

For more on preparing and packing your order, see our [packing guide][39].

How do I pack my luggage for shipping?

You can pack your luggage as you normally would for airline travel, no additional packaging is
necessary.

One of the advantages of using Luggage Forward is that your soft and hard sided luggage can be
shipped as is. However, sporting equipment and other non-luggage should have adequate padding around
any fragile or precision parts to ensure that they are protected during transit.

After your booking is placed, Luggage Forward will mail you a forwarding packet up to one week prior
to your pickup. The forwarding packet contains your itinerary, luggage tags, and relevant
instructions for packing and preparing your luggage for shipment with Luggage Forward. If you placed
a last-minute booking then the forwarding packet can either be emailed to you or it can be printed
at luggageforward.com by logging into [your account][40].

For more on preparing and packing your order, see our [packing guide][41].

What can I not ship?

Any hazardous or dangerous commodities are prohibited from all Luggage Forward shipments.

For shipments traveling between two countries, there are additional items restricted by customs.

You can not ship:
* Medication, OTC, prescription, or vitamins
* Food (Includes coffee beans and spices)
* Alcohol (including perfume and hand sanitizer)
* Tobacco
* Pressurized containers (includes sunscreen)
* Valuables or currency
* Electronics (excludes cables and converters)
* Lithium based, or Alkaline batteries (includes tracking devices and range finders)

Upon booking, you will be provided with a list of common items that are disallowed. If you have
specific questions, please contact one of our forwarding specialists or see our [Terms of
Service][42].

For additional items that cannot be shipped, please visit
[https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/][43].

Violators of the Federal Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR parts 100—185) may be subject to
civil penalties of up to $75,000 for each violation ($175,000 if the violation results in severe
injury or substantial destruction to property).

How far in advance of my trip should I book?

We offer same day bookings in many areas and if it is available on our website, we can do it.

If you like to plan ahead, we accept bookings up to 180 days prior to pickup.

**Last minute booking?**

We will ship customized luggage tags to your pickup location when time allows. Should you make a
last minute booking, please bear in mind you will most likely need to print out the labels and
documents to maintain the scheduled collection.

Can I lock my luggage?

**Domestic Shipments**

Bags traveling within a single country must be locked. Failure to lock items will void your right to
file a claim for lost or missing contents.

**International Shipments**

Bags shipped between two countries must be unlocked as they may have to be opened as a normal part
of the customs screening process. If bags are locked, including TSA approved locks, and customs
cannot open an item then the lock or seal may have to be broken.

Locking any item traveling internationally can cause extended delays and will void Luggage Forward's
industry leading on-time guarantee.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

## FANUC and Google: Advancing Manufacturing Intelligence

FANUC is collaborating with Google to bring cloud-native artificial intelligence capabilities to
manufacturing plants, enabling smarter automation and predictive analytics across all production
environments.

[ Read the Announcement ][133]

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

BelleFlex boosted production 10x by automating disc spring inspection with FANUC robots — replacing
slow, inconsistent manual checks with fast, precise, and reliable quality control.

## Loop, there it is!

Our newest destination has arrived!

Beginning in **May 2027**, fly to **Kamloops, British Columbia** with new twice-weekly seasonal
service. Whether you’re planning an outdoor escape, a business trip or exploring British Columbia’s
Interior, getting there has never been easier.

[Book Now!][75]
[Toronto]

## Toronto, We're Here!

Non-stop service between Whitehorse and Toronto has officially begun, making it easier than ever to
connect the Yukon with Canada’s largest city. Travel now until October. 

[Check Out YYZ][76]

Snake River, Yukon

## Chase The Midnight Sun

Long summer days mean more time to explore. Hike late into the evening, enjoy a patio under a
glowing sky, or simply experience the magic of the Yukon summer light. 

[Explore Now][77]
[three travellers embark on adventure looking up at mountain]

what you need! Take a look at our Air North Getaways deals and start your next adventure.

schedules, and modern, comfortable buses. Our extensive network spans 1,600+ destinations and our
online booking system and [our app][53] make planning your trip easy.

Booking your journey with Greyhound is simple. Our website and [app ][54]make it easy to find the
best fares and purchase your tickets securely. Whether you're planning ahead or making a last-minute
booking, we've got you covered. With our e-ticket system, boarding is hassle-free as your phone is
your ticket!

Hop on a Greyhound and discover some of the most exciting cities in the United States. Whether
you’re soaking up the history in [Philadelphia][55] or [Chicago][56], enjoying the nightlife in [New
Orleans][57] or [Las Vegas][58], exploring the big city life of [New York][59] or [Los Angeles][60],
or uncovering hidden gems in [San Francisco][61], our network of routes and frequent departures
makes it easy to experience everything the US has to offer.

## Greyhound: A Greener Way to Travel

Choosing Greyhound isn’t just smart—[it’s sustainable][62]. Traveling by bus reduces traffic and
emissions compared to driving by car, and we’re committed to making our operations even greener.
With high environmental standards across our fleet, alternative fuel options, and the ability to
offset your carbon footprint when buying tickets, Greyhound helps you travel responsibly.

a single prototype or a high-volume production run, Komacut streamlines the entire process — from
instant quoting and automated DFM feedback to ordering and delivery. With in-house manufacturing,
advanced equipment, and strict process control, we ensure consistent quality, fast lead times, and
cost-effective results tailored to your needs.

What file formats do you accept?
We support STP, STEP, and SLDPRT file formats. For the best results, please create your designs
using 3D sheet metal modules, which ensure accurate analysis and instant quoting through our
platform.
Do you have a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
No. You can order from just 1 PC for prototyping or scale up to thousands of parts for production.
How quickly can I receive a quote?
Quotes are generated instantly. Upload your CAD file to get real-time pricing, DFM feedback, and
lead times in seconds.
What materials are available?

Komacut offers a [broad selection][52] of sheet metals, including aluminum, stainless steel,
cold-rolled steel, hot-rolled steel, spring steel, and galvanized steel. Each material is available
in multiple grades and thicknesses to meet different design, strength, and performance requirements.

Is DFM feedback included with every quote?

Yes. Our [quoting system][53] automatically provides design-for-manufacturing feedback to help
reduce cost and improve manufacturability.

Where are Komacut’s facilities located?

Komacut operates modern, in-house manufacturing facilities in [China][54] and [Mexico][55]. This
dual presence allows us to serve both North American and global markets efficiently, with
competitive lead times and tariff advantages for USMCA-qualified parts shipped from Mexico.

Komacut is the digital manufacturing platform of Komaspec, a contract manufacturer with over 20

[Lewis Carroll Society of North America]

Welcome to the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) website. The LCSNA is a non-profit
organization dedicated to promoting awareness and appreciation of the life, work, times, and
influence of Lewis Carroll (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson). Through conferences, public programs,
publications, research projects, and communications, we work to create knowledge and share awareness
of Carroll’s contributions to society and culture around the world. We are collectors, scholars,
actors, and enthusiasts of all ages and walks of life who share an affinity for *Alice’s Adventures
in Wonderland* and its heroine Alice (and enjoy much of muchness).

[Lewis Carroll]

**Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, **
*better known as*
**Lewis Carroll** (1832–1898)

Part of the charter of the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) is to foster Lewis Carroll
studies and promote awareness of Carroll and his works. You can [donate][51] to any of our worthy
[LCSNA funds][52].

[Lewis Carroll Society of North America]

Welcome to the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) website. The LCSNA is a non-profit
organization dedicated to promoting awareness and appreciation of the life, work, times, and
influence of Lewis Carroll (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson). Through conferences, public programs,
publications, research projects, and communications, we work to create knowledge and share awareness
of Carroll’s contributions to society and culture around the world. We are collectors, scholars,
actors, and enthusiasts of all ages and walks of life who share an affinity for *Alice’s Adventures
in Wonderland* and its heroine Alice (and enjoy much of muchness).

[Lewis Carroll]

**Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, **
*better known as*
**Lewis Carroll** (1832–1898)

## [Join Us][47]

[Join Us]

If you would like to help, or if you simply enjoy Carroll’s writing, please review the benefits of
joining on our [Membership][48] page.

**[Members Only][49] content is available after you join the Society.**

## [Donate][50]

Part of the charter of the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) is to foster Lewis Carroll
studies and promote awareness of Carroll and his works. You can [donate][51] to any of our worthy
[LCSNA funds][52].
* [Happy Birthday, Lewis Carroll!] January 27 is Charles Lutwidge Dodgson’s birthday. He was born in
  1832 at Daresbury Parsonage, Cheshire.
  
   
  
  (Tatiana Ianovskaia, 2007)
* [The Knight Letter]
  
   
  
  All LCSNA members receive twice-yearly copies of the Society’s journal as they are published, free
  of charge.

# For the real cost of living

# Work that Works for Everyone

[Ikea team]

## #### What is the real Living Wage?

The real Living Wage is the only UK wage rate based on living costs.

## #### £13.45

the real Living Wage rate is independently calculated based on what it costs to live

## #### £14.80

the London Living Wage rate based on the higher cost of living in the capital

## #### 16,000

Over 16,000 UK Living Wage employers believe their staff deserve a decent wage. This means 1 in 7
workers now work for a Living Wage Employer.

## #### 490,000

Over 490,000 workers have received a pay rise as a result of the Living Wage campaign

## For the real cost of living

We are the movement ensuring everyone earns a wage to meet their needs.

[A group of LWF supports hold LWF signs]

### Who pays the Living Wage?

Over 16,000 responsible employers pay the Living Wage and are raising the bar through fair pay,
secure hours, and dignified work, including half of the FTSE 100, big household names including
Nationwide, Google, LUSH, Everton FC and Chelsea FC, as well as thousands of SMEs.

[Find out more][58]
[A speaker giving a talk at a LWF event]

### Our Mission

We’re driving up standards of good work so everyone has a decent standard of living now and in the
future. We are shaping the future of work to ensure security, dignity, and a fair wage for all
through our accreditations; Living Wage, Living Hours and Living Pension.

[Find out more][59]
[Tantrum doughnuts employees with doughnuts and living wage logo]

### Why pay the Living Wage?

We believe work should provide a decent standard of living for everyone; no-one should be in work
and unable to make ends meet, now or in their future. As well as helping workers to live with
dignity and security, 94% of Living Wage employers say their business has also benefitted from
accrediting.

[Find out more][60]
[Living Wage, Living Pension and Living Hours employer photo]

## Become a Living Wage Employer

Join the movement of thousands of responsible businesses who have chosen to transform millions of
people’s lives, and raise the bar for what decent work looks like. Take the first step to becoming a
Living Wage Employer today.

[Learn more][61]

Discover latest news, blogs and updates from the Living Wage Foundation and the wider Living Wage
movement.

# For the real cost of living

# Work that Works for Everyone

[Ikea team]

## #### What is the real Living Wage?

The real Living Wage is the only UK wage rate based on living costs.

## #### £13.45

the real Living Wage rate is independently calculated based on what it costs to live

## #### £14.80

the London Living Wage rate based on the higher cost of living in the capital

## #### 16,000

Over 16,000 UK Living Wage employers believe their staff deserve a decent wage. This means 1 in 7
workers now work for a Living Wage Employer.

## #### 490,000

Over 490,000 workers have received a pay rise as a result of the Living Wage campaign

## For the real cost of living

We are the movement ensuring everyone earns a wage to meet their needs.

[A group of LWF supports hold LWF signs]

### Who pays the Living Wage?

Over 16,000 responsible employers pay the Living Wage and are raising the bar through fair pay,
secure hours, and dignified work, including half of the FTSE 100, big household names including
Nationwide, Google, LUSH, Everton FC and Chelsea FC, as well as thousands of SMEs.

[Find out more][58]
[A speaker giving a talk at a LWF event]

### Our Mission

We’re driving up standards of good work so everyone has a decent standard of living now and in the
future. We are shaping the future of work to ensure security, dignity, and a fair wage for all
through our accreditations; Living Wage, Living Hours and Living Pension.

[Find out more][59]
[Tantrum doughnuts employees with doughnuts and living wage logo]

### Why pay the Living Wage?

We believe work should provide a decent standard of living for everyone; no-one should be in work
and unable to make ends meet, now or in their future. As well as helping workers to live with
dignity and security, 94% of Living Wage employers say their business has also benefitted from
accrediting.

[Find out more][60]
[Living Wage, Living Pension and Living Hours employer photo]

## Become a Living Wage Employer

Join the movement of thousands of responsible businesses who have chosen to transform millions of
people’s lives, and raise the bar for what decent work looks like. Take the first step to becoming a
Living Wage Employer today.

[Learn more][61]

## Trusted infrastructure for industry leading enterprises

For Enterprise IT

## Govern Kubernetes Without the Specialist Tax

Many organizations struggle to operate Kubernetes sustainably. Scarce specialists, massive tooling
ecosystems, and cluster environments sprawling across the enterprise make it difficult to maintain
control over container adoption: placing increasing pressure on governance, security, compliance,
and operational consistency.

This is the enterprise container management problem.

Portainer is the operational control plane that lets enterprise IT teams run Kubernetes and Docker
environments consistently, safely, predictably, and at scale: without depending on Kubernetes
specialists or platform engineering teams.

### Multi-Cluster Fleet Management

Centralized governance across Kubernetes clusters, and Docker hosts. Works with any Kubernetes
distribution: EKS, AKS, GKE, bare metal, or on-premises.

### GitOps Deployment Workflows

Centralized GitOps engine on the Portainer Server: not a controller running inside every cluster.
Promotion workflows from dev to staging to production with rollback, without the overhead of
distributed Argo or Flux installations.

### Self-Service with Guardrails

Enable developers to deploy safely without bottlenecks. Pre-defined templates, resource quotas, and
RBAC enforcement maintain control.

### Enterprise-Grade Identity & Access

Centralized SSO, LDAP, and OIDC integration. Role-based access control designed for real operational
teams with full audit logging.

## Govern Kubernetes Without the Specialist Tax

Many organizations struggle to operate Kubernetes sustainably. Scarce specialists, massive tooling
ecosystems, and cluster environments sprawling across the enterprise make it difficult to maintain
control over container adoption: placing increasing pressure on governance, security, compliance,
and operational consistency.

This is the enterprise container management problem.

Portainer is the operational control plane that lets enterprise IT teams run Kubernetes and Docker
environments consistently, safely, predictably, and at scale: without depending on Kubernetes
specialists or platform engineering teams.

### Multi-Cluster Fleet Management

Centralized governance across Kubernetes clusters, and Docker hosts. Works with any Kubernetes
distribution: EKS, AKS, GKE, bare metal, or on-premises.

### GitOps Deployment Workflows

Centralized GitOps engine on the Portainer Server: not a controller running inside every cluster.
Promotion workflows from dev to staging to production with rollback, without the overhead of
distributed Argo or Flux installations.

### Self-Service with Guardrails

Enable developers to deploy safely without bottlenecks. Pre-defined templates, resource quotas, and
RBAC enforcement maintain control.

### Enterprise-Grade Identity & Access

Centralized SSO, LDAP, and OIDC integration. Role-based access control designed for real operational
teams with full audit logging.

experience.

[Frame 1321316152 (3).png]

ABS

ABS is a popular choice for hardside luggage due to its durability and affordability. This
lightweight thermoplastic material offers excellent resistance to impact. Its lightweight nature
makes it easy to transport, while its rigid structure provides a sturdy barrier against rough
handling. For those seeking a balance of cost-effectiveness and reliability, ABS luggage is a
practical and stylish option.

[Frame 1321316153 (1).png]

Polycarbonate

Polycarbonate is a durable and lightweight material commonly used in premium luggage. Known for its
high impact resistance, polycarbonate provides excellent protection for your belongings while
keeping the luggage itself light and easy to maneuver. Its flexibility allows it to withstand rough
handling and harsh conditions, making it an ideal choice for frequent travelers.

[Frame 1321316154 (1).png]

Polyester

Polyester is a durable material known for its resistance to stretching and shrinking. Lightweight
and water-resistant, it offers a reliable option for travelers seeking dependable luggage without
added weight. With its balance of durability, affordability, and easy care, it is a great choice for
both casual and frequent travelers.

offer premium products at competitive prices, ensuring that our customers receive the best value
without compromising on quality. Backed by a team of dedicated professionals who are passionate
about what they do, we go above and beyond to deliver exceptional products and support that meet the
unique needs of our clients.

Our streamlined production process and strong supplier relationships allow us to keep costs down,

# Schengen Visa Information

For more than 12 years, **SchengenVisaInfo** has been providing complete and up-to-date information
on Schengen visas, ETIAS, and EES.

To date, we have informed and helped more than **280 million people**, in order to understand [how
to get a Schengen visa][109] and [what the entry requirements are to travel to Europe][110]. The
rules, guidelines and the information we provide are based on the [**EU Regulation 810/2009 (Visa
Code)**][111] and the official European Commission Guidance.

## Do You Need a Schengen Visa to Enter the Schengen Area?

**Whether you need a Schengen visa to enter into the Schengen Zone depends on your nationality.**
Use our visa wizard to instantly determine if you need a visa:

on Schengen visas, ETIAS, and EES.

to get a Schengen visa][109] and [what the entry requirements are to travel to Europe][110]. The
rules, guidelines and the information we provide are based on the [**EU Regulation 810/2009 (Visa
Code)**][111] and the official European Commission Guidance.

#### How Does the Visa Wizard Work?
* Choose your nationality and destination and click next to find out whether you will require a visa
  to enter the Schengen Zone.
* If a visa is needed: We will let you know where you should apply for it from your location.
* If a visa is not needed: We will inform you of the 90/180 day rule, as well as the upcoming ETIAS
  requirement for visa-free nationals visiting any of the Schengen member states.

**Important Note:** By 2026 the rules regarding visa-free nationals are changing. Late in 2026, all
visa-free nationals will be [required to obtain an ETIAS authorization prior to traveling to any of
the Schengen member states][112].

#### [See Complete List of Visa-Free Countries][113]

## What Is Schengen?

The term “Schengen” applies to the borderless zone which includes most European countries. It is the
biggest free travel area in the world. **It is a region of 29 European countries with no internal
borders, allowing the free and un-restricted travel of people across the area.** The total area
covered by the Schengen zone is approximately 4,718,084 km2 and contains a population of over 448
million people.

#### [**Complete Schengen Area Guide: How It Works, History, Border Rules & Special
#### Territories**][114]

## What is a Schengen Visa?

The Schengen visa is a short term entry to all 29 Schengen member states which allows you to enter
as a tourist, go on business, visit your relatives, receive medical care or for other short term
reasons.

Schengen visas are regulated by EU Regulation 810/2009 and allow a maximum of 90 days in total in
each 180 day time frame.

### Some key aspects of Schengen visa rules:
* **Duration of validity:** The duration of the visa is indicated on the visa sticker and indicates
  how many entries into the territory are possible
* **Type of entrance:** A single, double or multi-entry visa is possible
* **Valid for:** All 29 Schengen States (with the exception of visas with limited territorial
  validity)
* **Purpose:** Tourism, business meeting, family visit, medical treatment, cultural and sports
  events, short course
* **Prohibited use:** Working, long term studies, permanent residence

[Statistics 2024: Last year, there were over 11.7 million Schengen visas issued.][115] Approval
rates vary between 85-90%, depending on nationality and destination country.

## Where Can I Travel to With My Schengen Visa?

All travelers who receive a Schengen visa are able to travel freely throughout the entire Schengen
Area.
* Austria
* Belgium
* Bulgaria
* Czechia
* Croatia
* Denmark
* Estonia

In addition to being able to travel through the Schengen zone, [holders of a valid Schengen visa are
able to visit 11+ other countries that are not part of the Schengen zone, without needing to apply
for an additional visa][117].

## Getting a Schengen Visa

[The application procedure for the Schengen visa is uniform for all the Schengen states][118]
according to [the EU regulation no. 810/2009][119] (Visa Code). The requirements for submitting an
application and processing time may differ from one embassy to another.

#### How Does the Visa Wizard Work?
* Choose your nationality and destination and click next to find out whether you will require a visa

**Important Note:** By 2026 the rules regarding visa-free nationals are changing. Late in 2026, all
visa-free nationals will be [required to obtain an ETIAS authorization prior to traveling to any of
the Schengen member states][112].

#### [See Complete List of Visa-Free Countries][113]

## What Is Schengen?

The term “Schengen” applies to the borderless zone which includes most European countries. It is the
biggest free travel area in the world. **It is a region of 29 European countries with no internal
borders, allowing the free and un-restricted travel of people across the area.** The total area
covered by the Schengen zone is approximately 4,718,084 km2 and contains a population of over 448
million people.

#### [**Complete Schengen Area Guide: How It Works, History, Border Rules & Special
#### Territories**][114]

## What is a Schengen Visa?

The Schengen visa is a short term entry to all 29 Schengen member states which allows you to enter
as a tourist, go on business, visit your relatives, receive medical care or for other short term
reasons.

Schengen visas are regulated by EU Regulation 810/2009 and allow a maximum of 90 days in total in
each 180 day time frame.

### Some key aspects of Schengen visa rules:
* **Duration of validity:** The duration of the visa is indicated on the visa sticker and indicates
  how many entries into the territory are possible
* **Type of entrance:** A single, double or multi-entry visa is possible
* **Valid for:** All 29 Schengen States (with the exception of visas with limited territorial
  validity)
* **Purpose:** Tourism, business meeting, family visit, medical treatment, cultural and sports
  events, short course
* **Prohibited use:** Working, long term studies, permanent residence

[Statistics 2024: Last year, there were over 11.7 million Schengen visas issued.][115] Approval
rates vary between 85-90%, depending on nationality and destination country.

## Where Can I Travel to With My Schengen Visa?

All travelers who receive a Schengen visa are able to travel freely throughout the entire Schengen
Area.

application and processing time may differ from one embassy to another.

Send My Bag® is the leading international luggage and excess baggage shipping company. Serving
customers around the world, from the UK, US, Europe & Australia, to across Asia, Africa and South

1-2 days. Track your bag throughout its journey with  [local and international couriers][21] until
delivery. 

Check out Send My Bag's many [international destinations][22] and find out about customs procedures
and prohibited items. Our service is great for [international students][23], for [contractors
working abroad][24], and for [expats][25].

[Use a Luggage Courier to Avoid Airline Baggage Fees]

## Use a Luggage Courier Service to Avoid Airlines' High Baggage Fees

In a world where airline luggage allowances are slowly decreasing, but charges for excess baggage
are rapidly on the rise, airline customers are often disappointed with the very small amount of
luggage they can take with them on their trips. Many passengers choose budget airlines in a bid to
save money, only to discover that they have to pay extra in order to bring anything other than a
small item of hand luggage. Or, passengers travelling on [skiing][26], surfing or [golfing
holidays][27] may find that their outsized equipment and excess luggage are refused by the airline
unless an extortionate excess baggage charge is paid. Check out your airline’s baggage
fees [here][28].

[Send Baggage for a Hassle-Free Journey]

## Send Baggage for a Hassle-Free Journey

Why not send your luggage to make your journey more manageable? If you ship your baggage, you can
avoid long hours queuing at check-in desks and luggage carousels. Getting to and from the airport is
also a breeze when you send your luggage ahead, as you can easily jump onto public transport without
all your baggage in tow. If you are afraid that your airline will lose your baggage en route, you
can rest assured that Send My Bag® will forward your unaccompanied baggage to your destination safe
and sound.

[Ship Luggage at the Click of a Button]

## Ship Luggage at the Click of a Button

Send My Bag® has a [quick quote tool ][29]that estimates a delivery date for your luggage, and
provides our best rates for shipping excess luggage internationally at the click of a button.
Booking your luggage delivery with us couldn’t be easier. Our instructions guide you seamlessly
through the booking process, helping you fill out any necessary custom forms and providing you with
handy tips on how to pack your bags and what not to send. Booking your cheap luggage delivery is a
speedy process that can be completed within 5 minutes. Find out [how it works][30]!

[Send Your Excess Baggage]

## Send Your Excess Baggage for your Next Holiday or Year Abroad

This is where Send My Bag® comes in. We offer excess baggage shipping around the world, whether
you’re sending [golf clubs][31] to Portugal, shipping surf boards to Australia, or you need to send
luggage containing home comforts for a year studying abroad. We offer excellent rates, with
discounts for [student shipping][32], so you don’t need to fear the wrath of your airline’s excess
baggage charges.

Moving abroad? Take a look at our [Moving Abroad Checklist][33].

## Send My Bag App

The all new Send My Bag App is your ultimate shipping companion. Take photos of your belongings for
a FREE cover upgrade, track with a single click, receive push notifications straight to your phone
of important tracking events & more.

## Premium Collections

A 1 hour collection slot, call on arrival and additional waiting time are just a few of the
advantages of upgrading to a Premium Collection. Our drivers can also help you bring luggage and
boxes to the ground floor and will check all your shipping documents. Look out for the Premium
Collection option when booking.

[Our Luggage Courier and Delivery Service]

## Luggage Shipping & Delivery Service

Our student luggage delivery service takes the hassle out of moving to university or college.
Whether you’re a fresher heading to halls for the first time, or a returning student shipping
baggage between terms, Send My Bag collects your bags from your door and delivers them directly to
your university accommodation. No queues, no excess baggage fees, no stress. For relocating,
studying abroad or taking a trip, Send My Bag® is your dedicated personal effects shipping partner.

Over the last 15 years our service has grown to become the leading luggage shipping service. From
international students, to holiday homeowners, from film crews, to global relocation, our luggage
shipping and relocation services are relied upon by customers in over 80 countries each month.

By shipping baggage ahead you can save money, avoid excess baggage fees, skip the baggage carousel
and best of all, travel with whatever need, not what the airline restricts you to.

By using Send My Bag to ship your luggage for your relocation you can save money vs air freight and
time vs sea freight.

[Our Luggage Courier Guarantee]

## Our Guarantee

We guarantee we will always strive to deliver the best service, at the best price, complimented by
the best customer support. 

Our team is available 7 days a week, including 24hrs on weekdays. We handle 100,000+ chats every
year and our online call service means you can speak to us from around the world at no cost.

Determined to provide unparalleled value, we review pricing on all services every month and pass on
savings on variable costs such as fuel at the earliest opportunity.  

Over 100,000 independent reviews, hundreds of pieces of global press coverage and awards such as The
Queen's Award for Enterprise stand testament to our dedication to achieving and maintaining these
standards.

[Send Luggage Cheap]

## Send Luggage Cheap

Checking several bags onto your flight can be extremely costly, especially if you go over your
ticket’s baggage allowance. This can make travelling away for a long period of time, or moving
abroad indefinitely, a tricky process. This problem is solved by using Send My Bag® to send all your
bags to your destination, no matter how many you have. You can do so at cheap, affordable prices,
which means you don’t need to think twice about packing that extra outfit or spare pair of shoes.
Get a [quick quote][18].

Are you a student? Then check out Send My Bag's [student shipping service][19], which is an
excellent [alternative to college storage.][20] We offer fantastic student discounts to student
discount card holders.

[International Luggage Delivery Service]

## International Luggage Delivery Service

Send My Bag® is the leading international luggage and excess baggage shipping company. Serving
customers around the world, from the UK, US, Europe & Australia, to across Asia, Africa and South
America . Our drivers can collect right from your doorstep and deliver to most major cities within
1-2 days. Track your bag throughout its journey with  [local and international couriers][21] until
delivery. 

Check out Send My Bag's many [international destinations][22] and find out about customs procedures
and prohibited items. Our service is great for [international students][23], for [contractors
working abroad][24], and for [expats][25].

[Use a Luggage Courier to Avoid Airline Baggage Fees]

## Use a Luggage Courier Service to Avoid Airlines' High Baggage Fees

In a world where airline luggage allowances are slowly decreasing, but charges for excess baggage
are rapidly on the rise, airline customers are often disappointed with the very small amount of
luggage they can take with them on their trips. Many passengers choose budget airlines in a bid to
save money, only to discover that they have to pay extra in order to bring anything other than a
small item of hand luggage. Or, passengers travelling on [skiing][26], surfing or [golfing
holidays][27] may find that their outsized equipment and excess luggage are refused by the airline
unless an extortionate excess baggage charge is paid. Check out your airline’s baggage
fees [here][28].

[Send Baggage for a Hassle-Free Journey]

## Send Baggage for a Hassle-Free Journey

Why not send your luggage to make your journey more manageable? If you ship your baggage, you can
avoid long hours queuing at check-in desks and luggage carousels. Getting to and from the airport is
also a breeze when you send your luggage ahead, as you can easily jump onto public transport without
all your baggage in tow. If you are afraid that your airline will lose your baggage en route, you
can rest assured that Send My Bag® will forward your unaccompanied baggage to your destination safe
and sound.

[Ship Luggage at the Click of a Button]

## Ship Luggage at the Click of a Button

Send My Bag® has a [quick quote tool ][29]that estimates a delivery date for your luggage, and
provides our best rates for shipping excess luggage internationally at the click of a button.
Booking your luggage delivery with us couldn’t be easier. Our instructions guide you seamlessly
through the booking process, helping you fill out any necessary custom forms and providing you with
handy tips on how to pack your bags and what not to send. Booking your cheap luggage delivery is a
speedy process that can be completed within 5 minutes. Find out [how it works][30]!

[Send Your Excess Baggage]

## Send Your Excess Baggage for your Next Holiday or Year Abroad

This is where Send My Bag® comes in. We offer excess baggage shipping around the world, whether
you’re sending [golf clubs][31] to Portugal, shipping surf boards to Australia, or you need to send
luggage containing home comforts for a year studying abroad. We offer excellent rates, with
discounts for [student shipping][32], so you don’t need to fear the wrath of your airline’s excess
baggage charges.

Moving abroad? Take a look at our [Moving Abroad Checklist][33].

## Build your hybrid workforce.

Humans focus on judgment and empathy. AI agents execute work end to end at speed and scale.

[PLATFORM OVERVIEW][48]

## Autonomous agents.

Compose, deploy, and orchestrate specialized AI agents, each focused on a specific task, to execute
real CX work.

## Instant scalability.

Add agents, reuse skills, and coordinate how they operate across the customer journey, without
rebuilding workflows or adding complexity.

## Intent-driven execution.

Define goals, policies, and constraints while AI agents execute tasks and learn from real
interactions and outcomes.

## Real CX work, automated by AI agents.

[EXPLORE USE CASES][49]


### Appointments and directions

Confirm, update, and coordinate appointment details and directions in one flow.

[Reschedule Appointment Fallback]

### Order status and tracking

Provide end-to-end order visibility and delivery resolution with real-time updates.

[Wismo Fallback]

### Proactive travel notifications

Anticipate and notify customers of disruptions, policy changes and service updates.

[Proactive Travel Notifications Fallback]

### Card status and authorization

Verify, update, and manage card details and payment authorizations in real time.

[Use Case Payment Information Fallback]

## The most reliable AI agents in CX.

AI agents that act with domain-aware context, built-in validation, and continuous learning.

[DATA CLOUD][50]

### Industry-specific AI agents

Apply pre-trained agents for specific industries, use cases, and regulatory environments, so
decisions reflect real-world knowledge and constraints.

### Dynamic knowledge creation

Improve AI agents’ decisions over time by continuously creating and refining knowledge from live
interactions and enterprise data.

### Quality as a built-in control layer

Enforce reliability by validating behavior, decisions, and outcomes in real time, ensuring execution
remains accurate and controlled as volume scales.

[Use Case Payment Information Fallback]

VOICE IN ACTION

## Natural conversations, real outcomes.

Let customers speak naturally while AI agents reason through requests, apply real-time context, and
deliver accurate outcomes, so issues are resolved, not just answered.

Real results, straight from our customers.

**Krystal Roloff, **Director of CX store experience

**Karen Reyes, **VP of Global contact center

Humans focus on judgment and empathy. AI agents execute work end to end at speed and scale.

[PLATFORM OVERVIEW][48]

## Autonomous agents.

Compose, deploy, and orchestrate specialized AI agents, each focused on a specific task, to execute
real CX work.

## Instant scalability.

Add agents, reuse skills, and coordinate how they operate across the customer journey, without
rebuilding workflows or adding complexity.

## Intent-driven execution.

Define goals, policies, and constraints while AI agents execute tasks and learn from real
interactions and outcomes.

## Real CX work, automated by AI agents.

[EXPLORE USE CASES][49]


### Appointments and directions

Confirm, update, and coordinate appointment details and directions in one flow.

Anticipate and notify customers of disruptions, policy changes and service updates.

[Proactive Travel Notifications Fallback]

### Card status and authorization

Verify, update, and manage card details and payment authorizations in real time.

[Use Case Payment Information Fallback]

## The most reliable AI agents in CX.

AI agents that act with domain-aware context, built-in validation, and continuous learning.

[DATA CLOUD][50]

### Industry-specific AI agents

Apply pre-trained agents for specific industries, use cases, and regulatory environments, so
decisions reflect real-world knowledge and constraints.

### Dynamic knowledge creation

Improve AI agents’ decisions over time by continuously creating and refining knowledge from live
interactions and enterprise data.

### Quality as a built-in control layer

Enforce reliability by validating behavior, decisions, and outcomes in real time, ensuring execution
remains accurate and controlled as volume scales.

[Use Case Payment Information Fallback]

Let customers speak naturally while AI agents reason through requests, apply real-time context, and
deliver accurate outcomes, so issues are resolved, not just answered.

No more reaching out to all those suppliers for that destination or product. One platform for all
your customer’s need.

### Hotels

1M+ unique hotels, apartments and vacation homes globally. Allows Travel Agents to book
accommodations worldwide.

Offers the lowest airfares across the globe with local payment options. We also provide real-time
bookings of low-cost and full-service carriers worldwide.

We provide full-service custom luggage solutions, from design to manufacturing and distribution,
empowering renowned global brands to expand their product lines and enter new markets. 

[ Get in Touch ][15]

###### What do we do?

We specialize in designing, manufacturing, and distributing premium luggage, backpacks, and
multi-use bags for global brands across North America.

bagware is unmatched. We use advanced manufacturing technologies and top-quality materials, ensuring
every piece we produce meets the highest industry standards.

cost-effective distribution. No matter where you are, our streamlined processes guarantee that your
inventory is ready when you need it.

Sustainability is at the core of our manufacturing process. We prioritize eco-friendly materials,
reduce waste through efficient production, and adopt energy-saving technologies. By partnering with
us, you can be confident that your products are manufactured with respect for both quality and the
planet.

## Frequently Asked Question

All your questions about Axion answered

## What is the best size for a travel bag?

It depends on your trip length. For weekend trips, 30–40L is ideal. For longer travels, 60–100L is
better.

## Is it suitable for both boys and girls?

Yes, most school bags are unisex. However, some designs and colors may be more targeted toward
specific preferences.

## What size office bag should I buy?

It depends on what you carry. If you use a laptop, choose a bag that fits your laptop size (13",
15.6", or 17") and still has space for files, charger, and daily essentials.

## What is a jute bag made of?

Jute bags are made from jute fiber, a natural, biodegradable, and eco-friendly material often
referred to as the “golden fiber.”

## What size school bag is suitable for my child?

For young kids (ages 4–7), 10–15L is ideal. Older students (ages 8–14) may need 20–30L. High school
students may require 30L or more, especially if carrying laptops or sports gear.

## Can I carry a travel bag on a plane?

Yes, if it meets the airline's cabin baggage size and weight limits. Check with your airline before
flying.

## What is the best size for a travel bag?

It depends on your trip length. For weekend trips, 30–40L is ideal. For longer travels, 60–100L is
better.

## Is it suitable for both boys and girls?

Yes, most school bags are unisex. However, some designs and colors may be more targeted toward
specific preferences.

## What size office bag should I buy?

It depends on what you carry. If you use a laptop, choose a bag that fits your laptop size (13",
15.6", or 17") and still has space for files, charger, and daily essentials.

## What is a jute bag made of?

Jute bags are made from jute fiber, a natural, biodegradable, and eco-friendly material often
referred to as the “golden fiber.”

## What size school bag is suitable for my child?

For young kids (ages 4–7), 10–15L is ideal. Older students (ages 8–14) may need 20–30L. High school
students may require 30L or more, especially if carrying laptops or sports gear.

## Can I carry a travel bag on a plane?

Yes, if it meets the airline's cabin baggage size and weight limits. Check with your airline before
flying.
